name: Harvey Memory
desc: Memory carries forward user-chosen context (matter details, precedent, preferences, approved practices) and reuses past threads scoped to a user, client, matter or firm process. Firm admins enable/disable it; ethical walls and audit controls promised. Announced Jan 2026 as co-development with customers.

name: Hebbia Matrix
desc: Corporate / transactional due diligence. Parallel AI agents across large document sets with firm-specific configurations and review workflows. Configuration amounts to a shallow institutional memory layer; cross-matter persistent memory not documented.

name: Heidi Health
desc: Ambient documentation with clinician-profile learning. System learns each clinician's preferred note structure, phrasing patterns, symptom-outlining conventions — applies persistently across sessions. Provider-side personalisation rather than patient-longitudinal memory.

name: Hippocratic AI Polaris
desc: Patient-conversation / chronic-care staffing model. HIPAA-compliant Memory Store holds non-EHR salient facts from prior calls, persists across engagements, explicitly not used for model training. Shifts from transactional call-handling to longitudinal patient relationship.

name: Intercom Fin
desc: CX support. Currently CRM-backed customer attributes + conversation history lookup. Lifecycle-persistent memory ("priorities learned day one considered in year 10") on roadmap as of Pioneer 2025 — not yet shipped.
pricing: $0.99 per outcome (50/mo minimum on any-helpdesk plan); +$29/seat/mo on Intercom helpdesk; Pro add-on from $100/mo; 14-day free trial

name: Inworld AI
desc: Formerly an NPC character engine with named Long-Term Memory; now sells realtime voice models (TTS-2, STT-1, speech-to-speech) and OpenAI-compatible open-model inference. Character/NPC memory is no longer the headline product.
pricing: Usage-based: TTS-2 $25/1M chars on demand ($10 Enterprise); TTS-2 Flash $15/1M; STT-1 $0.10/audio-hour; open LLMs from $0.07/1M input tokens

name: Iris.ai
desc: Enterprise R&D document-intelligence platform, now sold as three products (Axion data prep, Neuralith enterprise knowledge engine, RSpace R&D intelligence) under an 'AI harness' that controls what models read and traces each answer step.

name: K Health
desc: Primary care / virtual physician intake. Two-agent pipeline: one extracts the relevant EMR subset, second answers grounded to that filtered history. Architecture explicitly diverges by patient condition (diabetic vs heart-failure get different responses to same intake).

name: Khanmigo
desc: Stores full chat transcripts per student (visible to learner and teacher via dashboard). Layers over Khan Academy's existing mastery graph (exercise completion, skill progress) for cross-session topic awareness; cross-session memory is derived from structured mastery state rather than free-text recall.
pricing: Teachers free; learners/families $4/mo or $44/yr; district pricing on request
type: Chat history + Khan Academy mastery state

name: LabGenius
desc: Therapeutic-antibody discovery in a closed Design-Build-Test-Learn loop. EVA accumulates structured outcome data from each robotic experiment cycle and feeds it back to generative ML models directing the next design round. Genuine experiment-memory-as-training-signal.

name: Latitude / Voyage
desc: AI Dungeon's maker. Voyage (April 2026) launched as a creator platform for AI RPGs. World Engine (5 years in dev) is dedicated AI tracking characters, objects, backstories, relationships independently from the narrative AI; persistent world state evolves with player choices.

name: LivePerson Conversation Context Service
desc: Architecturally notable — a named, documented service. Shared key-value store any agent (bot or human) can read/write across a customer's conversational journey, reducing repetition and enabling continuity.

name: Luminance Institutional Memory
desc: Jan 2026 platform relaunch. Persists negotiation history, prior decisions, accepted risk positions across all contracts; new terms align with what the org has already agreed. Branded as the antidote to "enterprise amnesia."

name: MagicSchool
desc: Teacher productivity platform (80+ teacher tools, 50+ student tools) for planning, differentiation, IEP generation, feedback. Does not maintain a cross-session learner model. Teachers input student context manually each session; district deployments can pre-populate fields via RAG over uploaded curriculum/policy documents.
type: Teacher tooling — no student-facing memory by design

name: MemoryVLA
desc: Two-tier memory bank on a VLA backbone. Perceptual MB holds low-level visual details; Cognitive MB holds high-level semantic summaries; working-memory module retrieves and fuses both into observation tokens before action prediction. Hippocampal + semantic-gist inspiration.

name: Meta-Memory
desc: Formalises spatial localisation question answering (SLQA). High-density memory over 3D scene graphs (semantic entities + metric coordinates); LLM agent performs joint retrieval over both modalities for multi-hop location queries. Introduces SpaceLocQA benchmark.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7
desc: Dual-system (VLM "System 2" + Diffusion Transformer "System 1") jointly trained end-to-end; planner outputs persist as conditioning context across action generation. N1.7 adopts relative end-effector action space — incremental spatial memory via positional history.
license: Apache-2.0 (code); model weights under NVIDIA Open Model License
type: Slow VLM planner + fast diffusion action model

name: NVIDIA ReMEmbR
desc: Builds long-horizon memory by captioning video segments with VILA, storing captions with timestamps + 3D position coordinates in MilvusDB. At query time, LLM iterates retrieval across text, time, and position modalities. Deployed on Nova Carter robot (Jetson Orin).

name: Nabla + Navina
desc: Ambient scribe + longitudinal clinical intelligence (strategic partnership Jul 2025). Live encounter transcript reconciled against historical labs/imaging/notes; condition-suspecting + care-gap engine runs against the reconciled record.
pricing: Free trial; pricing via sales (none published)

name: Nomi AI
desc: AI companion built around long-term memory as primary differentiator. Mind Map 2.0 gives users a navigable graph of what their Nomi knows about them and how memories connect — the most transparent memory model in the companion segment. Users can edit/delete nodes.

name: OpenEvidence (DeepConsult + Visits)
desc: Clinical decision support. Visits (Aug 2025) connects evidence layer to the live encounter — patient-specific context binding distinct from pure literature RAG. DeepConsult agent autonomously cross-references hundreds of peer-reviewed studies.

name: PolyAI
desc: Enterprise voice agents. Context heavily runtime-injected from CRM / telephony / API / user history; passes context to humans on escalation. Strong on plumbing, lighter on autonomous memory accumulation.

name: Quizlet — AI Study Tools / Magic Notes
desc: Tracks per-card answer history within a study set; computes a Memory Score for SRS scheduling. Magic Notes converts uploaded content (notes, PDFs, URLs) into flashcard sets automatically. Q-Chat, the conversational AI layer, was discontinued June 2025. Personalization is scoped to individual study sets, not a unified cross-subject learner model.
type: Per-set Memory Score (SRS) + Magic Notes generation

name: Replicant
desc: Enterprise agentic customer-service platform with Conversation Automation (one agent across voice, chat and messaging) and Conversation Intelligence (analysis of human-agent conversations used to replicate workflows). Cross-interaction memory is not documented.
deployment: Managed SaaS; multi-region failover; integrates with CCaaS/CRM/telephony; SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI

name: Replika
desc: Long-running AI companion (Luka, Inc., 2017). Replika 2.0 (2026) is a full rebuild with a new memory architecture, 3D avatars and voice/video calls; users report the new segmented, recency-biased memory losing some prior details. Classic app remains.
pricing: Classic: Free/Pro/Ultra/Platinum; Replika 2.0: Plus and Max plans (e.g. ~£59–66/yr in UK, Aug 2026)

name: ResearchRabbit
desc: Acquired by Litmaps (announced 2025-05-08, terms undisclosed); product still running. Literature discovery + citation mapping. Oct 2025 revamp formalises checkpointed search paths as named "rabbit holes" — each checkpoint is a saved state of the citation graph the user can branch from. Navigational memory rather than stateless re-querying.
pricing: Free; RR+ $10/mo annual or $12.50/mo monthly (parity discounts in 100+ countries); Institution custom

name: SG-Nav
desc: Incrementally constructs hierarchical 3D scene graph during navigation — nodes for objects/groups/rooms, edges for spatial relations. Prunes stale nodes with linear complexity. Live graph passed as structured prompt to LLM that traverses with chain-of-thought.

name: Salesforce Agentforce / Einstein
desc: Agentforce agents grounded in Data Cloud — unified customer record across silos. Memory is the CRM record made available to AI; not an independent memory system. AI reads/writes through the existing data model.
pricing: Flex Credits $500 per 100K credits; $2/conversation; user license $5/user/mo + credits; Agentforce add-ons $125–150/user/mo; Agentforce 1 Editions from $550/use
type: Customer 360 + Data Cloud as context layer

name: Sanctuary AI Carbon (Phoenix Gen 7/8)
desc: Carbon control system originally built for the Phoenix humanoid; company now sells it as hardware-agnostic Physical AI for existing industrial robots plus in-development hydraulic hands, with the Phoenix humanoid no longer featured.
type: Cognitive architecture with explicit task memory

name: SchoolAI
desc: Teacher-created "Spaces" (structured AI workspaces) where Dot, the student-facing assistant, guides learners through agendas. Student interaction data — completion, errors, time-on-task — surfaces to teachers via dashboards. Memory is within-space session context; the teacher holds the persistent profile, not the AI itself.
pricing: Free trial tier (5 Space launches/yr); Pro and Scale (district) tiers, prices on request
type: Teacher-configured Spaces with observable session logs

name: Scite.ai
desc: Stores surrounding textual context of every citation plus a deep-learning classification (supports / disputes / mentions). Persisted across the database, not computed on demand. MCP integration (2025) exposes the memory layer to Claude and ChatGPT.
deployment: Managed-only; acquired by Research Solutions Dec 2023
pricing: Basic $12/mo (billed yearly, 7-day trial); Pro $40/mo (billed yearly); Enterprise custom

name: Sierra
desc: Bret Taylor + Clay Bavor. Agent Data Platform links unstructured conversation data to enterprise systems (billing, inventory, policies, transactions); persists across channels and time. Memory accumulates across every interaction, not just within a session.

name: Skild Brain
desc: Real-time simultaneous inference + data collection — dynamically updates in-context representation as the robot encounters new situations. Lets the system adapt to novel embodiments / unseen environments without explicit fine-tuning. Pre-trained on internet human video + physics sim.
pricing: No public pricing; $4k–$15k target hardware cost enabled by Skild Brain
type: In-context real-time memory + live data collection

name: Soul Machines
desc: In receivership since 2026-02-05 (KPMG receivers); website still up. NZ/US digital-humans company. Patented Digital Brain simulates emotional state and learns from interactions. Cross-session Memories layer for user- and persona-specific context persistence. Deployed by ANZ Bank (Jamie) and Mercedes-Benz.

name: Speak
desc: Speaking-first AI language app (Spanish, French, Korean, Japanese, Italian, Chinese). Uses the learner's mistakes and history to generate personalised review; Premium Plus adds 'Made for You' lessons from gaps and an AI Speak Tutor. Business edition with admin progress tracking.
pricing: 7-day free trial; Premium and Premium Plus subscriptions (price varies by region, shown in-app); Speak for Business

name: Spellbook Library
desc: Transactional / contract drafting. Ingests the firm's precedent corpus (OneDrive, Dropbox or direct upload); indexes it so lawyers search past clauses in plain language inside Word, insert one, and have Spellbook adapt it to the style and context of the current deal. Goal: eliminate "reads like ChatGPT" output.
deployment: Managed SaaS inside Microsoft Word (plus Google Docs, iManage, SharePoint/OneDrive integrations)
pricing: 7-day free trial; paid pricing via sales (book a demo)

name: Spirit AI Character Engine
desc: Defunct: Spirit AI Limited entered members' voluntary liquidation (liquidators appointed 2023-09-18). Authoring toolkit + SDK for narrative designers. Tracks what each character knows, doesn't know, has witnessed; explicit handling of NPC knowledge inconsistency across sessions. Used in AR/VR and Alexa-style voice game contexts.

name: Suki AI
desc: Doctor-assist ambient documentation. Pulls forward prior documentation into a pre-visit synthesis rather than waiting for the encounter. Patient summaries surface relevant insight from history before visit begins.

name: Synthesis Tutor
desc: Embeds micro-assessments into every lesson to track understanding in real time, adjusting difficulty and teaching approach within session. Combines AI personalization with human-curated content. No publicly disclosed mechanism for a durable cross-session learner profile beyond progress tracking within its math curriculum scope (ages 5–11).
pricing: 7-day free trial; family ~$29/mo or $119/yr; individual $45/mo or ~$300/yr; lifetime $999–$1,499 (page figures inconsistent)

name: Tesla FSD V13 — Occupancy + 4D World (now FSD v14)
desc: Single end-to-end neural network ingesting multi-camera video + navigation + ego-motion, maintaining an evolving 3D occupancy volume as internal world state — spatial memory persisting across frames, tracking objects that temporarily leave the camera FOV. Row originally described V13; current line is FSD (Supervised) v14 — v14.3 (2026-04-07) rewrote the AI compiler and runtime with MLIR (~20% fast
deployment: On-device in Tesla vehicles; v14.x targets HW4/AI4
pricing: FSD (Supervised) $99/month subscription; subscription-only path on Tesla support page; requires FSD computer 3.0+

name: Wayve GAIA-2 / GAIA-3
desc: All surround-camera views encoded through video tokeniser to continuous latent; past latent sequences serve as explicit temporal context via space-time factorised transformer. GAIA-3 (15B params, 2× GAIA-2 size, 10× training data) adds safety-critical scenario generation + embodiment transfer.

name: π0.5 (Physical Intelligence)
desc: Extends π0 with MEM layer giving the policy short-term (within-task) + long-term (cross-task, >10-min horizon) memory. Co-trained on robot teleoperation + human video + text. Hierarchical inference: VLA predicts subtasks as text tokens, then executes as action chunks.
license: Apache-2.0 (openpi repo; repo also ships a LICENSE_GEMMA.txt for Gemma-derived t

name: Bee
desc: Acquired by Amazon (Jul 2025); bee.computer is now © Amazon and sells the Bee Frontier wearable ($74.99), with a Bee Eclipse device marked coming soon. Small wearable (pendant / clip / bracelet). Continuous capture; converts speech to text immediately; never stores raw audio . Daily summaries, personal fact sheet, to-do suggestions. Cloud processing on derived text only.
pricing: Bee Frontier bracelet $74.99 (sold via Amazon, launched 2026-10-15); Bee Pro subscription $11.99/mo (free tier keeps 14 days of memory); Bee Eclipse ($100) comi
type: Audio pendant — never stores raw audio

name: Era Computer
desc: Software platform / OS layer for AI wearables (glasses, rings, pendants, speakers) that abstracts hardware from AI orchestration. Memory and model providers are pluggable and user-controlled rather than cloud-locked; supports 130+ LLMs from 14+ providers. Founded 2025 by ex-Humane team.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
type: User-sovereign pluggable memory layer for wearable OS

name: Friend
desc: Pendant necklace (~2 inches). Always-on listening feeds a persistent AI companion persona. Companionship-framed rather than productivity / recall. Cloud LLM backend; no detailed encryption claims.

name: Granola
desc: Mac/iOS app (no hardware). Captures meeting audio via system-audio tap (no bot joining); generates notes from your shorthand + audio. Local audio processing claim; cloud for summaries. Enterprise tier opts out of model training.

name: Limitless
desc: Former Rewind/Limitless lifelog (Pendant wearable + screen/audio capture with timeline search). Acquired by Meta; Pendant no longer sold, desktop recording and Rewind shut down Dec 2025, legacy users supported through 2026.
pricing: Discontinued — no new sales since 2025-12-05; existing Pendant owners get Unlimited plan free

name: Memories.ai LVMM 2.0 / Project LUCI
desc: Developer-first reference platform for AI wearables. LVMM 2.0 captures visual data through video, encodes it into frames on-device, and stores moments as searchable memories; companion app surfaces past conversations/decisions/experiences. Hardware-level security via Qualcomm partnership; cloud sync for enterprise tiers.
pricing: Free 100 credits/mo; Plus $15/mo (5,000 credits, annual); Enterprise custom (incl. on-prem); usage API e.g. storage $0.03/GB-mo, search $0.10/1K queries
type: On-device Large Visual Memory Model for wearables

name: Omi
desc: Wearable orb (necklace or clip) with open-source hardware + firmware. Continuous audio capture; real-time GPT-4o transcription; searchable memory graph. Supports app screen capture too. Hybrid privacy: cloud by default (SOC 2/HIPAA/AES-256), full local/self-hosted available under MIT.

name: Otter.ai
desc: Joins Zoom / Meet / Teams as a meeting bot. Real-time transcription, speaker identification, searchable archive across past meetings. SSO + admin controls at Business tier.
pricing: Basic free; Pro $16.99/user/mo monthly or $8.33 annual; Business $30 list ($19.99 annual); Enterprise custom

name: Plaud NotePin
desc: Magnetic clip-on wearable. Records in-person conversations and calls; AI summaries, action items, searchable transcripts. AES-256 + TLS 1.2 in transit; doesn't retain audio after transcription. Also sells Note (card-form recorder) and Note Pro.
pricing: NotePin $159 / NotePin S $179 / Note Pro $189; Starter plan free (300 min/mo); Pro $17.99/mo or $99.99/yr (1,200 min); Unlimited $29.99/mo or $239.99/yr

name: Read.ai
desc: Meeting bot + browser extension. Captures audio + video; engagement scoring (talk-time, sentiment, attention); enterprise search across all past meetings. "Ada" digital-twin feature builds an AI memory of work patterns.
pricing: Free (5 meetings/mo); Pro $19.75/mo ($15 annual); Enterprise $29.75 ($22.50); Enterprise+ $39.75 ($29.75), per user
type: Meeting bot + analytics + Ada digital twin

name: Sandbar Stream
desc: Smart ring with voice-activated capture (tap to record, not always-on). Personal knowledge graph with companies, people, meetings; pulls context from past meetings and shared interests. Ex-Meta engineering team.
deployment: Managed-only; still listed as preorder on site as of Oct 2026
pricing: Ring preorder $249 (silver) / $299 (gold); Pro subscription $10/mo (free 3mo for preorders)
